prior_block:
PRICE PRIORS for recurring line types (statistical model fitted on the thresholds t revealed
in earlier games; gross amounts). How to use them:
- The amounts are final thresholds as they were revealed: they already contain whatever
  deductible, VAT and customary-price judgement applied in those cases, and they were computed
  from the full invoiced quantity (the whole quantity was indemnified there). For an
  indemnified line of this type take the stated amount for the line as t as it stands and give
  a price_log_sd that matches the stated range. Do not deduct a deductible from it and do not
  cut the invoiced quantity.
- Deviate only for something this case has and those cases did not: an aggregate cap or
  sub-limit that the lines of this invoice must share, a percentage reduction for a breached
  duty, or a purchase price or sum insured stated in the claim that limits the line.
- Whether a line is indemnified in THIS case is decided by the policy and the claim, not by
  the history. The history only says how often this line type was paid at all. A line type
  that was never indemnified before is usually an ancillary charge the policies do not carry;
  treat it as indemnified only if this policy clearly says so.
- line 4 "Shipping": indemnified in 1 of 7 earlier cases, t = 0 in 6; when indemnified t per pc about 26 (80% range 19.2 to 39); revealed per pc: 24-27 (case 24)

items.description: Translation from Spanish to English (police report)
items.rationale: Excluded by 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f): translation of documents for the purposes of the claim is not indemnifiable, regardless of necessity or who performs it.
Excluded by 7.1.8(e) and 7.1.8(f): working materials and ancillary charges raised alongside a non-indemnifiable translation charge are not indemnified.

items.description: Compensation for robbery damage (watch and cash)
items.rationale: Indemnified under 2.3.1, 4.2.2, 4.2.3, 4.2.4, 7.1.1, 7.1.5, 7.1.10: the watch (valuables) and cash (means of payment) were taken by force while away from the insured premises, reported to authorities. Sub-limits apply: valuables (EUR 2,500 per item, max EUR 5,000/event), means of payment (EUR 500/event), and away-from-premises aggregate (EUR 5,000/event). The watch is capped at EUR 2,500, cash at EUR 500, for a total of EUR 3,000 gross before deductible. Deductible of EUR 50 applies once per event, so t = 2,950.
Excluded by 7.1.8(b): carriage, shipping, delivery and comparable charges are not indemnified, even if raised on a settlement statement for indemnifiable property.
